key_concepts: PAGASA issues Modified Tropical Cyclone Wind Signals
Signal 1 means 39-61 km/h winds within 36 hours and minimal to minor damage
Signal 2 means 62-88 km/h winds within 24 hours and minor to moderate damage
Signal 3 means 89-117 km/h winds within 18 hours and considerable damage
Signal 4 means 118-184 km/h winds within 12 hours and severe damage
Signal 5 means 185 km/h or higher winds within 12 hours and severe to catastrophic damage
Higher storm signal numbers indicate stronger winds and greater potential damage
Storm impacts affect houses and buildings, plants and trees, power and water supply, and t
Preparedness actions differ before, during, and after a storm
Before a storm, people clean roofs, charge devices, and monitor forecasts
During a storm, people may evacuate to higher areas and monitor rain
After a storm, people listen to news and assess conditions
